_comment: Every fixture in this directory was saved from its live source before worker/feed/hr-date.ts or worker/feed/html.ts existed (task E1), and again before any dogadanja/*.ts parser existed (E2-E5). Each entry names the exact request that produced the file, its HTTP status, and the UTC instant it was fetched, so a later reader can tell a stale fixture from a live regression. robots.txt for every host below was read first; none disallows the path fetched (data.zagreb.hr/api/ is disallowed and is why this fixture uses the direct CKAN resource download URL instead of the package_show endpoint).

fixtures.notes: WordPress REST, custom post type kp_22_announcement, 40 most recent announcements. Confirms the research finding: no acf, no meta field carries a date. The date exists only as Croatian prose inside excerpt.rendered (e.g. item 85612: 'odrzava se od 22. do 29. rujna'), the year is never written, and the category comes from class_list (kp_22_announcement_cat-*).

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://aktivnosti.zagreb.hr/robots.txt does not exist (server returns the site's own 200 HTML for the path, not a robots file) -> no crawl restriction declared
fixtures.notes: Plain HTML listing, no JSON/RSS alternative found on the site. Confirms the research finding: no per-item date and no district anywhere in the markup, only a title, a thumbnail and a link per item.

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://skupstina.zagreb.hr/robots.txt does not exist (server returns the site's own 200 HTML, not a robots file) -> no crawl restriction declared
fixtures.notes: The Assembly's own schedule/calendar page ('Rokovnik sjednica'), page 1 of 2. Rows are with an inner dd.mm.yyyy.title; several rows near the top carry no at all (older/committee sessions the page no longer dates), a real quirk a parser must tolerate rather than assume away.

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://skupstina.zagreb.hr/robots.txt does not exist -> no crawl restriction declared
fixtures.notes: One plenary session page, linked from the rokovnik listing above ('Poziv na 13. sjednicu Gradske skupstine Grada Zagreba'). page-text carries the Croatian prose 'Srijeda, 16. rujna 2026. s pocetkom u 9:00 sati u Staroj gradskoj vijecnici...'. The static nav/footer on every page of this site links the Assembly's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRMm4Xt9ruoQ8FG7NpIHCsA) as 'Prijenos sjednice' -- that is the linked live page R-P5 keeps, never the disallowed YouTube feeds/videos.xml path.

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://data.zagreb.hr/robots.txt disallows /api/, /revision/, /dataset/*/history and /dataset/rate/ (Crawl-Delay 10). The path fetched is /dataset/<id>/resource/<id>/download/data.json, which is none of those, so it is allowed; the package_show metadata endpoint (/api/3/action/package_show) is NOT fetched here for that reason -- the resource URL is already pinned in docs/izvori.md from stage 1.
fixtures.notes: 700 records, 'Plan komunalnih aktivnosti'. Confirms two research findings: X_Koordinata sits at ~45.7 (Zagreb's latitude) and Y_Koordinata at ~15.8-15.9 (Zagreb's longitude) -- the axes are swapped versus the GeoJSON convention -- and string fields carry numeric HTML entities for Croatian diacritics (e.g. 'Brezovi\u010dka' appears as 'Brezovičcka', S\u030c as Š/š, Z\u030c as Ž/ž, C\u0301 as ć).

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://www.zet.hr/robots.txt does not exist (404) -> no crawl restriction declared
fixtures.notes: General ZET news feed, standard RSS 2.0 with CDATA titles/descriptions. Entities present: &   " ' „ • € “ ” ’. First item's description again carries Croatian date prose ('u subotu, 12. rujna, od 9 do 19 sati').

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://www.zet.hr/robots.txt does not exist (404) -> no crawl restriction declared
fixtures.notes: Traffic-disruption notice feed, same RSS 2.0 shape as rss_novosti.aspx. Same entity set minus ' and •.

fixtures.robotsTxt: https://emz.hr/robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/ (explicitly allows /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php); the wp-json path fetched is unaffected
fixtures.notes: WordPress REST, custom post type 'dogadjanja' (events/activities). Confirms the research finding: real structured meta exists (webmz_event_date_start, webmz_event_date_end as Unix seconds, webmz_event_place), so this source is read directly and never through parseHrDate.

Same custom-field shape as dogadjanja, post type 'izlozbe' (exhibitions). Contains several items whose webmz_event_date_end already lies in the past relative to this fetch (e.g. id 22339, 22334, ends 2026-08-16), which is exactly the case E5 must exclude.
